name: Facet
text: Choose dark mode by default with a one-click toggle to light mode. It reduces eye strain in low light and keeps focus on the data, which aligns with our goal of clarity and liveliness. The trade-off is that some users may prefer light mode for high-contrast readability, but the toggle keeps the decision in their hands without cluttering the interface.

name: Pane
text: Pane: Dark mode hides errors when contrast drops—like Manus’s analysis warns. A high-contrast dark toggle still risks the same problem if users tweak colors. Better: default to light mode with a *low-contrast* toggle, since light backgrounds expose errors by default. Settle it with A/B tests measuring error detection speed and user preference.
